propositions: Raw ordered scan of ticket event files (REVIEW_RESULT and COMPLETION_VERDICT JSON) must read all record kinds (plan_review_result_v2, completion_verifier_pass/fail_v1, gate_error_v1) by schema and timestamp, not via filtered helper functions.
llm_calls and latency derivations must sum only from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics; COMPLETION_VERDICT carries no metrics and must not be used for cost computation.
cost_per_accepted_change is summed llm_calls divided by count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records; returns None (Unavailable) when zero accepted closes exist to avoid division by zero.

first_pass_verification computes the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first chronological) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1 by scanning raw COMPLETION_VERDICT files in filename order.

env_diagnosis_interval pairs each gate_error_v1 ERROR with the next PASS record for the same gate (matching on error.gate field against same-gate PASS schema); interval is PASS.timestamp minus ERROR.timestamp; unpaired ERRORs are open intervals.
All metrics register into registry.py with source="sidecar" and confidence="high"; only read-side derivations with no writes to sidecars.
